coverage_of_risk.rationale: The suite touches only trivial leaf helpers; every high-risk module (data transformation, filtering, sorting, pagination, URL state, error paths) is untested.

app/src/app/shared/format.spec.ts:16-18 — orDash(null) vs orDash(0) pins observable spec behaviour, not internals
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: The tests that exist are behavioural, but they cover so little observable surface that 'behavioural throughout' can't be claimed; most behaviour simply has no test.

evidence: app/src/app/shared/format.spec.ts:5-6 — exact spec examples (mr-mime → 'Mr Mime'); these assertions can and do fail on real regressions

regression_power.rationale: The three tests have real teeth for the helpers they cover (including the falsy-zero trap), but they guard roughly 20 of 876 significant LOC; breaking the data layer, filters, or sorting would pass the suite.

evidence: app/src/app/shared/format.spec.ts:4-19 — three lean cases, each pinned to a SPEC definition; no padding or duplicated variants
app/src/app/shared/format.spec.ts:11-12 — boundary covered (#0025 and #1026) with one case, no sprawl
signal_to_noise.rationale: No noise at all: every test earns its keep and maps to a spec rule. The only mild criticism is that the rendered equivalents are partly asserted by the acceptance suite, so the marginal guard is small.

findings.issue: The entire server-side data layer (~400 LOC) has no tests: alternate-form exclusion (163), dedupe key (265), method ordering (287-293), selected-game fallback (252), effect-chance substitution (130-133), and page-path routing (391-416).
findings.suggestion: Extract toCards, the move-table assembly, latestFlavorText/shortEffect and loadPageData's routing as pure functions and test them against small API fixtures covering edge cases (IDs at 10000, deoxys-normal refs, missing effect entries, malformed escapes).

findings.issue: Filter matching, page-count/clamping (55-59), page-reset-on-filter (86-90) and the debounced search + linkedSignal/pushedQ synchronisation (40-79) are untested.
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/page computation into pure helpers and unit test: out-of-range and non-numeric page params, filter combinations, search against humanized names, and that changing a filter resets page to 1.

findings.issue: The sort comparator's missing-values-last-in-both-directions handling, tie-break and direction flip (106-111) have no coverage; one acceptance test sorts a single column ascending/descending.
findings.suggestion: Move the row ordering into a pure function and test each column with null power/accuracy/level present, both directions, and the asc→desc flip including aria-sort state.

findings.issue: toUrl's three accepted URL shapes and the cache-eviction loop (60-68) are untested; a refactor of the '/api/v2/' marker slicing or eviction condition could double-slash URLs or evict fresh entries.
findings.suggestion: Unit test toUrl('pokemon/25'), toUrl('/api/v2/pokemon/25/'), toUrl(absolute URL from API data), and the eviction behaviour past MAX_ENTRIES.

findings.issue: TransferState consume-once (hasKey/get/remove) and the 60s client cache with error eviction (17-28) are untested; a regression could re-fetch on hydration or cache rejected promises permanently.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests with a fake loader asserting hydration reuse, cache expiry, and that a failed fetch is evicted so a retry can succeed.

findings.issue: Resolver-null → NotFound rendering and the 404 RESPONSE_INIT status (app/src/app/pages/not-found/not-found.ts:8-12) have no app-level test; the malformed-URI path (app/src/server/loaders.ts:395-397) likewise.
findings.suggestion: A component-level render test of a page given a null vm, plus a unit test of loadPageData returning null for unknown names, extra path segments and bad percent-encodings.

findings.issue: Title logic (vm===null → 'Not found', vm.title fallback, en-dash format) is untested.
findings.suggestion: Unit test updateTitle against synthetic RouterStateSnapshots: home, resolved page, null vm, and not-found route data.

findings.issue: Height/weight conversion (divide by 10, one decimal), stat total and barWidth clamping are untested.
findings.suggestion: A few pure-function assertions (or extracting the formatters) for 0.4 m / 6.0 kg and 100% clamp.

findings.issue: Scroll-restoration state machine (page-change vs filter-only-change detection) is untested.
findings.suggestion: Covered by framework behaviour for the simple cases; if kept, at least a comment-level test of the changedPage condition would help future refactors.

findings.issue: The vitest unit-test builder is configured but used for only one trivial spec file, giving a false sense of a tested codebase.
findings.suggestion: Prioritise the data layer and home/move-table logic above; those tests are cheap and would run in 'ng test'.

summary: The agent wrote three clean, behavioural, spec-pinned unit tests — and nothing else. All of the logic most likely to break (the loaders data transformation, home filtering/pagination/URL state, move-table sorting, error and not-found paths) is guarded only by the acceptance suite. Overall a token gesture: correct in form, near-zero in protective value.
valuableTests: shows missing values as an em dash — pins orDash(null)→'—' vs orDash(0)→'0', the falsy-zero trap that would render 0 PP/accuracy as an em dash
humanizes API names — locks the exact spec transform (mr-mime → 'Mr Mime', thunder-punch → 'Thunder Punch') used by every label and link in the app
formats dex numbers — locks the 4-digit zero-padding (#0025) shown on every card and heading
